values.note: A single roadside site on Wertz Road 0.52 mi from Blankley Road: a grass lot that holds 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents, with fire ring, picnic table and hitching post. Back-in, max vehicle length 60 ft (site 105 x 55 ft, 60-ft grass driveway).

Grass parking lot that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from the roadway. Site has a fire ring, picnic table, and a hitching post.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Permit and reservation required, online or by calling 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/buchanan/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880263&siteId=29281 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site (CV011 Martin Hill North, Chaneysville loop) with a 60-ft max vehicle length, reservation required (fcfs never), open year round. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
